label: Stop depth

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 5.4 #34 (measurement family section 5.1, species values section 5.3: puma CT [D], rest [E])

range.endpoint_anchor: stop depth / L: 0.06 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.12 -> -100 = -0.06, +100 = 0.18 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.06) / 0.12)

region.mask_rule: frontal block at the stop window, vertical step; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Vertical rise of the dorsal profile across the stop window (+/-0.05 L about the stop station) - the vertical component of the break. StopAngle (head.stop.angle) tilts the nasal plane; this steps the frontal block up/down; they are different deformations (spec section 5.1). In short-faced felids the window captures the frontal RAMP (panther +75 [D]). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
